items.title: Dave Liebman — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Often you hear, “I went to my uncles, and I heard Benny” [Goodman] – not that I recall.

ctx.x: How about Sam Butera with Louis Prima?

Not at that time, nope, no. There was no jazz – jazz, swing, Benny. None of that was in the house, that I remember, and I didn’t have any relatives. Often you hear, “I went to my uncles, and I heard Benny” [Goodman] – not that I recall.
You mentioned getting polio, which happened pretty early in your life, right?
